direction_notes: Open-label, uncontrolled; self-administered group reported lower depression (CESD-5) and several symptom items improved; objective cognitive battery and caregiver ratings unchanged.
safety_notes: No serious or unanticipated events; headache (15.4%) and transient jaw clenching (3.8%) possibly related; none caused discontinuation.

timing.protocol_description: Three 5-min sessions per day (alternatively two 7.5-min), in cycles of 3 consecutive weeks of daily use followed by a 1-week break, repeated for the duration of participation. Self-administered at home.
